title: Unit 35 Consolidation: Public Speaking & Rhetoric
goal: Consolidate formal audience address, negative fronting, rhetorical clefts, live digressions and persuasive consecutive clauses.

items: I can address a live audience with formal vocatives and consistent ustedes courtesy.
I can use negative and restrictive fronting and rhetorical clefts to spotlight a thesis.
I can steer brief spoken asides and return cleanly to the speech's main thread.
I can contrast achieved rhetorical results with intended persuasive effects.
